name: StatusWall 状态墙
description: 为小机群设计的 Komari 状态墙：Solarized 玻璃卡片，一屏看全每台机器的 CPU / 内存 / 硬盘、流量与配额、三网延迟丢包状态条、价格与剩余价值，没有地图和地球。A Solarized glass status wall for small Komari fleets: every metric on the card, three-network ping status strips, no maps.
author: 0xoo

help.zh-CN: 通过 /api/clients WebSocket 拉取实时数据的间隔，2–30 秒。
help.en: Interval for pulling live data over the /api/clients WebSocket, 2–30s.

help.zh-CN: 波形带与三网走势覆盖的时间范围，窗口越长单次请求的数据量越大。
help.en: Time span of the trace band and ping trend; longer windows fetch more data.

help.zh-CN: 展开卡片后的四张逐小时趋势图（CPU、内存、硬盘、网络）。关闭后详情只列数字。
help.en: The four hourly charts (CPU, memory, disk, network) in the expanded card. Turn off to list numbers only.

help.zh-CN: CPU、内存、硬盘或流量使用率达到该值时标黄，达到 95% 标红。
help.en: CPU, memory, disk or traffic turns amber at this value and red at 95%.

help.zh-CN: 填机器名或 UUID，多个用逗号 / 空格 / 分号分隔，例如 node-a, 8acf。UUID 可以只写前 4 位（后台机器列表里能看到），大小写不敏感；名字里带空格时请用逗号分隔（如 my server, node-a），只写名字会把同名的都隐藏。被隐藏的机器不显示卡片，也不计入汇总、提醒与页脚统计。
help.en: Node name or UUID, separated by comma / space / semicolon, e.g. node-a, 8acf. A 4-char UUID prefix is enough (see the UUID in the admin node list); case-insensitive. Separate names that contain spaces with commas (e.g. my server, node-a); a plain name hides every node with that name. Hidden nodes show no card and are excluded from totals, alerts and the footer.

help.zh-CN: 开启后，离线机器永远排在在线机器后面（置顶的机器仍最前）；离线状态变化时卡片会平滑换位。
help.en: When on, offline nodes always sort after online ones (pinned nodes still come first); cards reorder smoothly when a node goes offline.

help.zh-CN: 显示在页脚最后，适合放 ICP 备案号或一行说明（最多 80 字）。留空就不显示。
help.en: Shown at the end of the footer, e.g. an ICP filing number or a short note (max 80 chars). Leave empty to hide.

help.zh-CN: 只接受 http(s) 链接；填写后备案文字变成新标签页打开的链接，留空则只显示纯文字。
help.en: http(s) only. When set, the footer text becomes a link that opens in a new tab; empty renders plain text.

help.zh-CN: auto 跟随系统；light 为 Solarized Light 暖色；dark 为 Solarized Dark。页面右上角也有切换按钮。
help.en: auto follows the system; light is Solarized Light; dark is Solarized Dark. A toggle also sits in the top-right corner.

help.zh-CN: 顶栏右侧的「登录 / 后台」按钮，指向 /admin。关闭后访客看不到入口，直接访问 /admin 仍可登录。
help.en: The Login / Admin button in the header, linking to /admin. Turning it off only hides the button; /admin still works.

name.zh-CN: 显示价格、成本与剩余价值
name.en: Show price, cost and remaining value

help.zh-CN: 关闭后页面不出现任何金额，适合公开站点。
help.en: Hide all amounts, useful for a public site.

name.zh-CN: 美元汇率（1 美元 = ? 人民币）

help.zh-CN: 汇总月成本与剩余价值时把美元价格折算成人民币，行内仍显示原币种。
help.en: Used to convert USD prices for the CNY totals; rows keep their original currency.

name.zh-CN: 欧元汇率（1 欧元 = ? 人民币）

help.zh-CN: 汇总时把欧元价格折算成人民币。
help.en: Used to convert EUR prices for the CNY totals.
